source: FloorPlanCAD original PanCADNet baseline, arXiv:2105.07147 v2, Tables 5 and 6 (official numbers: PQ=0.561, SQ=0.838, RQ=0.660)

provenance.discrepancy: A later reported PQ of 59.5 uses a different protocol and is not verified here; do not treat it as the official PanCADNet number.

notes: Documentation only. This project scores proxy pixel IoU on a 100-canvas / 1000-raster, 1 px stroke, same-class strict Hungarian > 0.5, micro aggregation. Those normalisations differ from PanCADNet (length-weighted vector IoU, macro over classes), so the value is NOT directly comparable and is loaded as 'incomparable_normalization' if passed to --baseline; it must never become a pass/fail gate. No substitute threshold is invented here.
